description: Add-on for Metallum (the Metal backend for Minecraft on macOS): built-in shaders, stutter fixes and a frame-hitch profiler for Apple Silicon.

mods.name: Metallum Extra
mods.description: Add-on for Metallum: built-in shaders (sun shadows, lit water, glow), stutter fixes and a frame-hitch profiler for the Metal backend on Apple Silicon.

releases.notes:
First public build. For Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric, with Metallum 0.0.23 or 0.0.24.

- Built-in shaders for Metal (experimental, off by default; needs Sodium)
- Stutter and frame-rate fixes: unlocked frame rate with VSync off, smooth chunk crossing, smooth memory cleanup
- Compatibility: Distant Horizons, Shine, multiple render targets, more textures per shader
- Frame-hitch profiler (off by default)

Put the jar in your instance's `mods` folder next to Metallum. See the README for details.
